license_required.quote: The practice of medicine or an attempt to practice medicine without a license to practice in Florida.

age_minimum.quote: Is at least 21 years of age.

degree_required.value: graduate of an allopathic medical school or allopathic college recognized and approved by an accrediting agency recognized by the United States Office of Education
degree_required.quote: Is a graduate of an allopathic medical school or allopathic college recognized and approved by an accrediting agency recognized by the United States Office of Education

accrediting_body.value: accrediting agency recognized by the United States Office of Education
accrediting_body.quote: recognized and approved by an accrediting agency recognized by the United States Office of Education

degree_level.quote: Is a graduate of an allopathic medical school or allopathic college recognized and approved by an accrediting agency recognized by the United States Office of Education

school_approval_basis.quote: recognized and approved by an accrediting agency recognized by the United States Office of Education

credential_pegged.quote: Is a graduate of an allopathic medical school or allopathic college recognized and approved by an accrediting agency recognized by the United States Office of Education

required.quote: Has completed an approved residency of at least 1 year.

experience_source.quote: Has completed an approved residency of at least 1 year.

duration.value: at least 1 year (domestic graduates); at least 2 years for certain foreign medical graduates after October 1, 1992
duration.quote: Has completed an approved residency of at least 1 year.

kind.quote: Has completed an approved residency of at least 1 year.

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)
exams.notes: Board may also accept combinations with FLEX or NBME examinations up to the year 2000; SPEX available for certain long-practicing applicants.
exams.quote: Has obtained a passing score, as established by rule of the board, on the licensure examination of the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)

interval_years.quote: The department shall adopt rules establishing a procedure for the biennial renewal of licenses.

required.quote: the Board of Medicine, the Board of Osteopathic Medicine, the Board of Chiropractic Medicine, and the Board of Podiatric Medicine shall each require licensees which they respectively regulate to periodically demonstrate their professional competency by completing at least 40 hours of continuing education every 2 years.

hours_per_period.quote: completing at least 40 hours of continuing education every 2 years

period_years.quote: completing at least 40 hours of continuing education every 2 years

value: 2-hour course on prevention of medical errors (including root-cause analysis, error reduction, and patient safety, plus information on 5 most misdiagnosed conditions)
2-hour course on prescribing controlled substances (for DEA registrants)
2-hour course on domestic violence (every third biennial renewal)
1-hour course on HIV and AIDS (first renewal)
topical_requirements.quote: The boards, or the department when there is no board, shall require the completion of a 2-hour course relating to prevention of medical errors as part of the biennial renewal process.

available.quote: The department shall issue a license by endorsement to any applicant who, upon applying to the department on forms furnished by the department and remitting a fee set by the board in an amount not to exceed $500, the board certifies has: (1) Met the requirements for licensure by endorsement under s. 456.0145

requirements.value: Licensure by endorsement available under the MOBILE Act (s. 456.0145): active unencumbered license in another state, national exam or certification, 2 years active practice in 4 preceding years, no pending discipline, no adverse action in prior 5 years, financial responsibility and fingerprinting requirements. Interstate Medical Licensure Compact also available for eligible physicians.
requirements.quote: Met the requirements for licensure by endorsement under s. 456.0145

national_certification.value: Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG)
national_certification.quote: Has had his or her medical credentials evaluated by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates, holds an active, valid certificate issued by that commission, and has passed the examination utilized by that commission

national_association.quote: the fellowship experience and training must be counted toward regular or subspecialty certification by a board recognized and certified by the American Board of Medical Specialties

regulatory_model.quote: The practice of medicine or an attempt to practice medicine without a license to practice in Florida.

credential_type.quote: Each applicant who meets the requirements of this chapter shall be licensed as a physician, with rights as defined by law.

is_mandatory.quote: The practice of medicine or an attempt to practice medicine without a license to practice in Florida.

title_protection.quote: Leading the public to believe that one is licensed as a medical doctor, or is engaged in the licensed practice of medicine, without holding a valid, active license.

scope_protection.quote: The practice of medicine or an attempt to practice medicine without a license to practice in Florida.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to obtain, obtaining, or renewing a license by bribery, fraudulent misrepresentations, or board/department error.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to obtain, obtaining, or renewing a license to practice medicine by bribery, by fraudulent misrepresentations, or through an error of the department or the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license or authority to practice medicine revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against by any licensing authority.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license or the authority to practice medicine revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against, including the denial of licensure, by the licensing authority of any jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of or pleading nolo contendere to a crime that directly relates to the practice of medicine or the ability to practice medicine.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of, or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a crime in any jurisdiction which directly relates to the practice of medicine or to the ability to practice medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: False, deceptive, or misleading advertising.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: False, deceptive, or misleading advertising.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report to the department any person the licensee knows is in violation of this chapter or the rules of the department or the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the department any person who the licensee knows is in violation of this chapter or of the rules of the department or the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding, assisting, procuring, or advising any unlicensed person to practice medicine.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding, assisting, procuring, or advising any unlicensed person to practice medicine contrary to this chapter or to a rule of the department or the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to perform any statutory or legal obligation placed upon a licensed physician.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to perform any statutory or legal obligation placed upon a licensed physician.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a report the licensee knows to be false, or intentionally or negligently failing to file a required report.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report which the licensee knows to be false, intentionally or negligently failing to file a report or record required by state or federal law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying or receiving any commission, bonus, kickback, or rebate, or engaging in any split-fee arrangement for patient referrals.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Paying or receiving any commission, bonus, kickback, or rebate, or engaging in any split-fee arrangement in any form whatsoever with a physician, organization, agency, or person, either directly or indirectly, for patients referred to providers of health care goods and services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Exercising influence within a patient-physician relationship for purposes of engaging a patient in sexual activity.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Exercising influence within a patient-physician relationship for purposes of engaging a patient in sexual activity.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in or related to the practice of medicine or employing a trick or scheme.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in or related to the practice of medicine or employing a trick or scheme in the practice of medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting patients through fraud, intimidation, undue influence, or overreaching conduct.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Soliciting patients, either personally or through an agent, through the use of fraud, intimidation, undue influence, or a form of overreaching or vexatious conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to keep legible medical records that identify the responsible physician and justify the course of treatment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to keep legible, as defined by department rule in consultation with the board, medical records that identify the licensed physician or the physician extender and supervising physician by name and professional title who is or are responsible for rendering, ordering, supervising, or billing for each diagnostic or treatment procedure and that justify the course of treatment of the patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Exercising influence on the patient to exploit the patient for financial gain.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Exercising influence on the patient or client in such a manner as to exploit the patient or client for financial gain of the licensee or of a third party

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing professional services not duly authorized by the patient or client.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing professional services which have not been duly authorized by the patient or client, or his or her legal representative

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering a legend drug other than in the course of the physician's professional practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing, administering, mixing, or otherwise preparing a legend drug, including any controlled substance, other than in the course of the physician's professional practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering any medicinal drug to oneself.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering any medicinal drug appearing on any schedule set forth in chapter 893 by the physician to himself or herself

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being unable to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety by reason of illness, substance use, or mental/physical condition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being unable to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness or use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing medical malpractice, gross medical malpractice, or repeated medical malpractice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing medical malpractice as defined in s. 456.50. The board shall give great weight to the provisions of s. 766.102 when enforcing this paragraph.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing procedures or prescribing therapy constituting experimentation on a human subject without informed written consent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing any procedure or prescribing any therapy which, by the prevailing standards of medical practice in the community, would constitute experimentation on a human subject, without first obtaining full, informed, and written consent.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law or performing professional responsibilities the licensee is not competent to perform.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law or accepting and performing professional responsibilities which the licensee knows or has reason to know that he or she is not competent to perform.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating professional responsibilities to a person not qualified by training, experience, or licensure.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Delegating professional responsibilities to a person when the licensee delegating such responsibilities knows or has reason to know that such person is not qualified by training, experience, or licensure to perform them.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a lawful order of the board or department or failing to comply with a lawfully issued subpoena.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a lawful order of the board or department previously entered in a disciplinary hearing or failing to comply with a lawfully issued subpoena of the department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to supervise adequately physician assistants, paramedics, EMTs, APRNs, or anesthesiologist assistants.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to supervise adequately the activities of those physician assistants, paramedics, emergency medical technicians, advanced practice registered nurses, or anesthesiologist assistants acting under the supervision of the physician.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresenting or concealing a material fact at any time during any phase of a licensing or disciplinary process.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresenting or concealing a material fact at any time during any phase of a licensing or disciplinary process or procedure.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report to the board within 30 days if action has been taken against one's license in another state, territory, or country.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the board, in writing, within 30 days if action as defined in paragraph (b) has been taken against one's license to practice medicine in another state, territory, or country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising or holding oneself out as a board-certified specialist when not qualified.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising or holding oneself out as a board-certified specialist, if not qualified under s. 458.3312, in violation of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with requirements to provide patients with information about their patient rights and how to file a complaint.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to comply with the requirements of ss. 381.026 and 381.0261 to provide patients with information about their patient rights and how to file a patient complaint.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing deceptive or fraudulent expert witness testimony related to the practice of medicine.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Providing deceptive or fraudulent expert witness testimony related to the practice of medicine.

insurance_required.quote: an applicant must by one of the following methods demonstrate to the satisfaction of the board and the department financial responsibility to pay claims and costs ancillary thereto arising out of the rendering of, or the failure to render, medical care or services

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Each pain-management clinic must register with the department or hold a valid certificate of exemption pursuant to subsection (2).

temporary certificate for areas of critical need

registration of resident physicians and interns
general licensing and continuing education provisions

definition_quote.value: "Practice of medicine" means the diagnosis, treatment, operation, or prescription for any human disease, pain, injury, deformity, or other physical or mental condition.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of medicine" means the diagnosis, treatment, operation, or prescription for any human disease, pain, injury, deformity, or other physical or mental condition.

methods_authorized.quote: "Practice of medicine" means the diagnosis, treatment, operation, or prescription for any human disease, pain, injury, deformity, or other physical or mental condition.

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe or administer controlled substances under Schedules II-V for the treatment of intractable pain; prescribe controlled substances subject to standards for acute and chronic nonmalignant pain; and prescribe Schedule II amphetamines only for specified conditions.
drug_authority.quote: a physician may prescribe or administer any controlled substance under Schedules II-V, as provided for in s. 893.03, to a person for the treatment of intractable pain, provided the physician does so in accordance with that level of care, skill, and treatment recognized by a reasonably prudent physician under similar conditions and circumstances.

license_status_types.quote: A license that has become inactive may be reactivated under s. 458.319 upon application to the department.

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must either attend a school certified by the department under s. 458.314 and hold an ECFMG certificate with passing examination score, or meet alternative criteria including a US bachelor's degree, WHO-listed school, and completion of formal requirements plus NBME/ECFMG exam equivalents. All foreign medical graduates must demonstrate English competency. Post-October 1, 1992 graduates from non-certified foreign schools must complete at least 2 years of approved residency or fellowship.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: Is a graduate of an allopathic foreign medical school which has not been certified pursuant to s. 458.314 and has not been excluded from consideration under s. 458.314(8); Has had his or her medical credentials evaluated by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates, holds an active, valid certificate issued by that commission, and has passed the examination utilized by that commission; and Has completed an approved residency or fellowship of at least 2 years in one specialty area.

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: Has completed an approved residency of at least 1 year.

pain_management_education_required.quote: the appropriate board shall require each person registered with the United States Drug Enforcement Administration and authorized to prescribe controlled substances pursuant to 21 U.S.C. s. 822 to complete a board-approved 2-hour continuing education course on prescribing controlled substances

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: For acute pain, Schedule II opioids may not exceed a 3-day supply unless the prescriber documents medical necessity, in which case up to 7 days may be prescribed. Prescriptions for nonacute pain must be labeled 'NONACUTE PAIN'. For traumatic injuries with Injury Severity Score of 9 or greater, an emergency opioid antagonist must be concurrently prescribed.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: For the treatment of acute pain, a prescription for an opioid drug listed as a Schedule II controlled substance in s. 893.03 or 21 U.S.C. s. 812 may not exceed a 3-day supply, except that up to a 7-day supply may be prescribed if: 1. The prescriber, in his or her professional judgment, believes that more than a 3-day supply of such an opioid is medically necessary

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: A physician licensed under chapter 458, chapter 459, chapter 461, or chapter 466, a physician assistant licensed under chapter 458 or chapter 459, or an advanced practice registered nurse licensed under part I of chapter 464 who prescribes any controlled substance, listed in Schedule II, Schedule III, or Schedule IV as defined in s. 893.03, for the treatment of chronic nonmalignant pain, must: (a) Designate himself or herself as a controlled substance prescribing practitioner on his or her practitioner profile.

pain_management_clinic_registration_requ.quote: Each pain-management clinic must register with the department or hold a valid certificate of exemption pursuant to subsection (2).

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A telehealth provider may not use telehealth to prescribe a controlled substance listed in Schedule II of s. 893.03 unless for: treatment of a psychiatric disorder; inpatient treatment at a licensed hospital; treatment of a patient receiving hospice services; or treatment of a nursing home resident.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A telehealth provider may not use telehealth to prescribe a controlled substance listed in Schedule II of s. 893.03 unless the controlled substance is prescribed for the following: 1. The treatment of a psychiatric disorder; 2. Inpatient treatment at a hospital licensed under chapter 395; 3. The treatment of a patient receiving hospice services as defined in s. 400.601; or 4. The treatment of a resident of a nursing home facility as defined in s. 400.021.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: A health care professional not licensed in this state may provide health care services to a patient located in this state using telehealth if the health care professional registers with the applicable board, or the department if there is no board, and provides health care services within the applicable scope of practice established by Florida law or rule.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is hereby enacted into law and entered into by this state with all other jurisdictions legally joining therein

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: "Supervision" means responsible supervision and control. Except in cases of emergency, supervision requires the easy availability or physical presence of the licensed physician for consultation and direction of the actions of the physician assistant.

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: A supervising physician may delegate to a fully licensed physician assistant the authority to prescribe or dispense any medication used in the supervising physician's practice unless listed on the formulary; Schedule II controlled substances are limited to a 7-day supply; prescriptions must include the PA's name, address, and telephone number and supervising physician names.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: A supervising physician may delegate to a fully licensed physician assistant the authority to prescribe or dispense any medication used in the supervising physician's practice unless such medication is listed on the formulary created pursuant to paragraph (f).

max_physician_assistants_per_supervising.quote: A physician may not supervise more than 10 currently licensed physician assistants at any one time.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Any practitioner of medicine licensed pursuant to the provisions of chapter 458 ... shall report to the Office of Insurance Regulation any claim or action for damages for personal injury alleged to have been caused by error, omission, or negligence in the performance of such licensee's professional services

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: The department shall be notified when any physician: ... Has been disciplined by a licensed hospital, health maintenance organization, prepaid health clinic, ambulatory surgical center, or nursing home or the medical staff of such a hospital ... for any act that constitutes a violation of this chapter.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The department may retain one or more consultants to operate its impaired practitioner program.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: the department shall have, upon a finding of the State Surgeon General or the State Surgeon General's designee that probable cause exists to believe that the licensee is unable to practice medicine because of the reasons stated in this paragraph, the authority to issue an order to compel a licensee to submit to a mental or physical examination by physicians designated by the department.
